content.short: BlueMove is a community-first NFT marketplace on Aptos and Sui, featuring trader rewards and advanced trading tools.
content.description:
BlueMove is a leading multi-chain NFT marketplace tailored for the Move ecosystem, supporting both the Aptos and Sui networks. It distinguishes itself through a community-centric model where users earn MOVE tokens for trading activities. The platform also features a dedicated launchpad for new collections, providing creators with tools for whitelist management and instant royalty payments upon sale.

Beyond basic trading, BlueMove offers professional-grade features such as floor price sweeping, bulk transactions, and mass bidding. All trading fees are distributed back to MOVE token stakers, fostering a sustainable environment for collectors and creators alike. The marketplace aims to be the primary hub for digital assets across Move-based blockchains.
